name: Accenture

ASE / Advanced ASE.dsaDepth: Light–Moderate — cognitive test plus a coding round; coding difficulty is lower than product-company bars, communication is weighted heavily
rounds: Communication Assessment (English ability: sentence correction, reading comprehension, error-spotting)
Cognitive and Technical Assessment (about 90 min: verbal, logical reasoning, numerical ability, plus a technical section on pseudo-code/flowcharts/networking/MS Office for technical streams)
extraTopics: Verbal and written communication (a whole stage is dedicated to it)
Basic logical reasoning and numerical aptitude
Pseudo-code / flowchart reading for the technical assessment
